def grid_block(text, start_marker, n):
    lines=text.splitlines(); i=next(i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith(start_marker))+1
    return [[int(v) for v in line.split()] for line in lines[i:i+n]]
d2i_exact=grid_block(u2,'Demo pair 2 input (15x19):',15)
d2o_exact=grid_block(u2,'Demo pair 2 output (15x19):',15)
print(set(map(len,d2i_exact)),set(map(len,d2o_exact)),mod.transform(d2i_exact)==d2o_exact)
print([(r,c,d2o_exact[r][c],mod.transform(d2i_exact)[r][c]) for r in range(15) for c in range(19) if d2o_exact[r][c]!=mod.transform(d2i_exact)[r][c]])
